inicio.intro_quote: [EN] Every horse born at Total Equines carries generations of excellence, discipline, and the unmatched passion of Argentine polo.
inicio.intro_text: [EN] We are a stud farm dedicated to the selective breeding of high-performance polo horses, combining the world's finest genetic lines with the unique environment of the Argentine pampas.
inicio.highlights_tradition_text: [EN] Decades of experience breeding the finest polo horses in the country, with deep respect for Argentina's equestrian heritage.
inicio.highlights_genetics_text: [EN] Rigorous selection of the best stallions and maternal lines, national and international, to produce high-performance specimens.
inicio.highlights_global_text: [EN] Our horses compete and win on the world's most prestigious fields. We export to Europe, the United States, and Asia.
inicio.cria_maternales_text: [EN] The finest broodmares selected across generations.
inicio.ventas_subtitle: [EN] Current selection of specimens available for national and international acquisition.
inicio.cert_subtitle: [EN] Endorsed by leading national and international equestrian institutions.

footer.tagline: [EN] Breeding champions from the Argentine pampas to the world.

nosotros.hero_subtitle: [EN] A passion passed down through generations.
nosotros.story_p1: [EN] Total Equines was born from a deep passion for Argentine polo and the selective breeding of high-performance horses. Since our beginnings, we have worked tirelessly to combine the world's finest genetic lines with the unique character of the Argentine horse.
nosotros.story_p2: [EN] Our estancia, located in the heart of the Argentine pampas, is home to exceptional specimens raised with the highest standards of health, nutrition, and training. Every horse that leaves Total Equines carries the seal of excellence.
nosotros.story_p3: [EN] We work with the best riders, veterinarians, and equine genetics specialists to ensure our horses are not only beautiful but also champions on the field.
nosotros.tl_2010_text: [EN] Total Equines is born with the vision of breeding Argentina's finest polo horses.
nosotros.tl_2013_text: [EN] Our first specimen competes and wins at the Interior Open Tournament.
nosotros.tl_2016_text: [EN] We begin exporting horses to Europe and the United States.
nosotros.tl_2019_text: [EN] We obtain official certification for international sanitary export.
nosotros.tl_2022_text: [EN] Three of our horses participate in the Argentine Open Polo Championship at Palermo.
nosotros.tl_2024_text: [EN] Total Equines present in 12 countries with over 200 horses exported.
nosotros.team_1_bio: [EN] Over 20 years of experience in polo horse breeding. Amateur polo player with a 4-goal handicap.
nosotros.team_2_bio: [EN] Equine genetics specialist with studies in Argentina and New Zealand. Responsible for stallion selection.
nosotros.team_3_bio: [EN] Former professional polo player, responsible for the training and sports evaluation of all specimens.
nosotros.mission_before: [EN] OUR MISSION IS TO BREED HORSES THAT
nosotros.mission_subtext: [EN] Every decision we make — from genetic selection to training — is guided by a single goal: excellence on the field.

lacria.intro_text: [EN] Our breeding program combines decades of experience with the latest techniques in equine genetics. We rigorously select each cross to maximize the athletic capabilities, temperament, and sporting longevity of our specimens.
lacria.card1_text: [EN] The mares that define our generations.
lacria.card2_text: [EN] The stallions that make the difference.
lacria.phil_01_text: [EN] Only specimens with the best sporting and health records are chosen for our breeding program.
lacria.phil_02_text: [EN] We combine Argentine lines with the best international genetics to maximize athletic potential.
lacria.phil_03_text: [EN] Each foal receives a personalized development plan from birth to sporting debut.
lacria.phil_04_text: [EN] We certify and document every step of the process. Our buyers know the complete history of each animal.

maternales.hero_subtitle: [EN] The genetic foundation of our stud farm.
maternales.intro_text: [EN] Maternal lines are the heart of Total Equines. Each broodmare was selected for her athletic ability, temperament, and capacity to pass on her best characteristics to her offspring.
maternales.line_1_desc: [EN] Foundational line of Total Equines, present in over 40% of our current production.
maternales.line_1_offspring: Bravo de Cañuelas, Tempestad del Sur, Aguante Porteño
maternales.line_2_desc: [EN] Cross with English Thoroughbred blood that provides explosive speed and superior athleticism.
maternales.line_2_offspring: La Mora IV, Viento Norte, Estrella Federal
maternales.line_3_desc: [EN] Introduced from New Zealand, provides durability and excellent character on the field.
maternales.line_4_desc: [EN] Selected for perfect athletic conformation and cool-headedness under competitive pressure.
maternales.line_5_desc: [EN] Unique combination of North American genetics with the grit of the Argentine horse.
maternales.line_6_desc: [EN] Well-balanced specimens, ideal for different positions and playing styles.

padrillos.hero_subtitle: [EN] The stallions that define our genetics.
padrillos.intro_text: [EN] Our stallions are selected with the most demanding criteria in the Argentine polo world. Each stallion combines a proven sporting record with the physical characteristics and temperament needed to transmit excellence to his offspring.
padrillos.s_1_desc: [EN] Exceptional stallion with 8 seasons on the professional circuit. Winner of three Argentine Opens, his offspring stand out for their explosiveness and unmatched competitive character.
padrillos.s_2_desc: [EN] A masterful cross between the Argentine Criollo and the English Thoroughbred. His offspring inherit the rusticity and resistance of the Criollo with the speed and athleticism of the Thoroughbred.
padrillos.s_2_b1: [EN] Sire of La Mora IV and Tempestad del Sur
padrillos.s_2_b3: [EN] Exports to USA, UK and Australia
padrillos.s_3_desc: [EN] Imported from New Zealand, he brings a different genetic perspective. His offspring are characterized by their longevity, cool-headedness, and exceptional recovery capacity.
padrillos.s_4_desc: [EN] Pure representative of the Polo Argentino breed at its finest. Transmits the temperament, tactical intelligence, and short speed that characterize the world's best polo horse.
padrillos.s_4_b1: [EN] Most prolific sire at Total Equines
padrillos.s_4_b3: [EN] Argentine Open — sire of the 2023 MVP

subastas.hero_subtitle: [EN] Adquirí los mejores ejemplares de Total Equines en nuestros eventos exclusivos.
subastas.faq_q1: [EN] ¿Cómo me registro para participar en una subasta?
subastas.faq_a1: [EN] El registro es gratuito y se realiza a través del formulario en esta página o contactándonos directamente por email o WhatsApp. Una vez registrado, recibirás toda la información del evento, catálogo de ejemplares y condiciones de venta.
subastas.faq_a2: [EN] Sí. Nuestras subastas presenciales incluyen la opción de participación online en tiempo real. Recibirás acceso a la plataforma de puja virtual con video en vivo y podrás realizar tus ofertas desde cualquier parte del mundo.
subastas.faq_a3: [EN] Cada caballo subastado cuenta con documentación completa: pedigree certificado, historial veterinario, certificados sanitarios SENASA, registro de la Asociación Argentina de Caballos de Polo y, cuando aplica, pasaporte FEI para exportación internacional.
subastas.faq_a4: [EN] Aceptamos transferencia bancaria internacional (SWIFT), pago en USD o EUR. Para compradores internacionales ofrecemos asistencia completa en el proceso de exportación y documentación aduanera.
subastas.faq_q5: [EN] ¿Qué sucede si gano una subasta desde el exterior?
subastas.faq_a5: [EN] Nos encargamos de todo el proceso de exportación. Coordinamos la logística, veterinaria de viaje, certificaciones sanitarias internacionales y transporte hasta el destino final. Trabajamos con las principales empresas de transporte equino del mundo.
subastas.faq_q6: [EN] ¿Puedo visitar los caballos antes de la subasta?
subastas.faq_a6: [EN] Absolutamente. Alentamos a los compradores interesados a visitar nuestra estancia antes del evento. Coordinamos visitas con pruebas en cancha, revisión veterinaria independiente y reunión con nuestro equipo. Contactanos para agendar tu visita.
subastas.newsletter_text: [EN] Suscribite para recibir el catálogo completo antes de cada evento y acceso prioritario al registro.
subastas.newsletter_thanks: [EN] ¡Gracias! Te avisaremos antes del próximo evento.
subastas.newsletter_privacy: [EN] Sin spam. Podés darte de baja cuando quieras.
